claims.text: The authors compare their method with previous work on reducing out-of-vocabulary (OOV) rates in neural machine translation (NMT).
They also compare their method with two previous methods: subword and fully character-based approaches.
Previous work included methods that integrated morphological information in both statistical machine translation (SMT) and NMT.
The authors reference a fully character-based baseline system as part of their comparisons.
